cover: Compliance rules a giving platform can't skip

slides.title: Screen where every gift passes
slides.body: One function every donation route goes through, before a record is written or a payment exists.

slides.title: Decline without saying why
slides.body: Telling someone they matched a sanctions list is itself a violation, so the message stays neutral.

slides.title: If the check fails, so does the gift
slides.body: When the lists can't be queried, the donation is declined. A check that switches off protects nobody.

slides.title: Record the passes too
slides.body: Logging only the blocks can't prove you screened everyone. Clears go on record alongside them.

slides.title: Tune the name match
slides.body: A naive check flagged six of twenty ordinary names. One extra word of slack brought it to three.
